selection_rationale: This fleet is built to fire as many torpedoes as possible: 64 rounds, 12 per 30 s volley. The plan is to launch mass salvos from long range and overwhelm any enemy point defence, while the torpedo cruiser's 241 cm nose armour and 4 PD lasers anchor the group.
formation_rationale: The torpedo cruiser sits 60 km back so it's the last ship the enemy's guns can reach while its torpedoes still have the range to hit. The two corvettes go forward and out to the sides, splitting left/right and up/down, so they take the first exchange and give enemy spinal weapons no single line through the fleet. Each corvette is about 100 km from the Harpoon, which is near the edge of PD overlap. The two corvettes are about 95 km apart, so they can cover each other against incoming torpedoes.
